raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Addresses the independent model fixes called out in #38695.

Several MoE models still discard router precision at model-specific boundaries:

- MiMo-V2, Ernie4, and Kimi Linear can construct the checkpoint correction bias in bf16, even though expert selection consumes it in fp32-sensitive score arithmetic.
- Bailing MoE and Bailing MoE Linear compute with fp32 router weights when configured, then cast the logits back to the hidden-state dtype before top-k.

These paths either collapse checkpoint bias values or throw away the fp32 router output immediately before expert selection.

LLaDA2 originally had the same router-output downcast, but #31768 fixed that path independently. The current PR therefore leaves LLaDA2 untouched.

## Modifications

- Keep `e_score_correction_bias` parameters in fp32 for MiMo-V2, Ernie4, and Kimi Linear.
- Return the gate GEMM output at the router-weight dtype for Bailing MoE and Bailing MoE Linear.

The patch is limited to five model files. It does not introduce a shared `RouterGate`, add a kernel, or change expert computation.

## Accuracy Tests

No new unit test is included, following the maintainer guidance in #38695 that these model-file fixes do not require one. The changes only preserve the dtype already selected for the correction bias or router GEMM output.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. No kernel is added. The Bailing paths remove a dtype-conversion operation when the router is configured for fp32.

## Test Plan

- [x] Rebased onto current `main` (`961bcf481d`).
- [x] Python bytecode compilation for all five changed files.
- [x] `pre-commit run --files <all changed files>`.
- [x] `git diff --check`.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code according to the contribution guide.
- [x] Follow the requested model-file-only scope.

@b8zhong I rebased this PR onto current `main` (`0b635266d4`) and narrowed it according to your guidance in #38695.

- Removed the added unit-test file; the diff is now limited to the six model files.
- Kept the two independent fixes identified in the issue: FP32 correction biases for MiMo-V2/Ernie4/Kimi Linear, and removal of the router-logit downcast for Bailing MoE/Bailing MoE Linear/LLaDA2.
- Resolved the MiMo-V2 rebase conflict without restoring the upstream-removed `reduce_moe_output` path.
- All pre-commit hooks for the changed files and `git diff --check` pass.

The resulting patch is 9 insertions and 26 deletions and remains separate from the shared `RouterGate` refactor. Could you please take another look at the updated minimal scope when convenient? I can still split the two fix groups if that is specifically preferred.

Rebased onto current main at 961bcf481d.

The only conflict was LLaDA2: #31768 has independently landed the same router-output precision contract, so I dropped that hunk rather than duplicate it. The PR is now limited to the five still-unfixed model paths (Bailing MoE, Bailing MoE Linear, Ernie4, Kimi Linear, and MiMo-V2).

Validation after rebase: Python bytecode compilation, repository-pinned pre-commit on all changed files, and git diff --check all pass.

Rebased onto current main at `4d5692b6cd` after the shared model-stage refactor in #43460. The refactor touched four of the same model files but not the router-output or correction-bias contracts, so the five-path precision patch remains unchanged in scope.

Post-rebase validation: repository pre-commit on all five files, Python bytecode compilation, and `git diff --check` all pass. The current head is `f4b4bee257`.
